Counting 20 days forward from 2026-11-19 (i.e. 2026-11-19 + 20 days) lands on 2026-12-09. Checking the weekday: 2026-11-24 is a Tuesday (given), so counting forward day-by-day, 2026-12-09 falls on a Wednesday — not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so no § 193 BGB adjustment is needed.
